intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri lifts one foot and glares at her shoe.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: It has a heel like a nail and a bow the size of a cabbage.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “These are marvelous for entrances. Everyone hears me coming.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “They’re useless for exits. Everyone hears me going.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Something that can slip out of a dull party. Slippers. Socks. A small cart.”

options.labelText: “Get the slippers. I’ll walk loudly next to you as a decoy.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “A decoy! You’re hired. Royal adviser for practical footwear.”

options.labelText: “But they’re fantastic shoes. Isn’t that worth a bit of hobbling?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She sets her foot down with a click. All the way out, everyone hears her going.
